_doc: Ground-truth planted bugs in fixture2/index.html (InvoicePad Mini — a second, generator-untuned fixture; see README.md's 'Second fixture (fixture2) — the generator-untuned measurement target' section). Same schema as seeds.json: the scorer matches a findings file against these seeds and prints true bug-recall PER AXIS. axis roll-ups: 'functional' = functional + broken-journey; 'ux' = ux-objective. A finding is credited to a seed ONLY via finding.seedId or finding.judgedSeedId (set by attribute.js's judge). seed.match keywords are a HINT the judge uses to pick candidate seeds — they are NEVER credited by the scorer directly (no keyword-only matching). This fixture and its seeds were authored under a firewall discipline (no read of skills/generating-qa-checklist, skills/analyzing-feature-ui, or any skills/*/SKILL.md) so the fixture is not tuned to the checklist generator's known coverage gaps.

gate._note: Absolute per-axis recall + overall precision. Negative-control seeds (polarity:negative) must NOT be flagged; flagging one is a false positive. Mirrors seeds.json's gate exactly — no threshold was tuned to make fixture2 pass.

seeds.title: Tax is computed on the pre-discount subtotal instead of the discounted subtotal (order-of-operations divergence from the on-page pricing rules)
seeds.oracle: Add one line item: qty=100, unit price=$6.00 (not tax-exempt). subtotal = $600.00; subtotal > $500 so a 10% discount applies: discount = $60.00, discounted subtotal = $540.00. Per the visible pricing rules, tax = 8% of the DISCOUNTED subtotal = 8% x $540.00 = $43.20, and grand total = $540.00 + $43.20 = $583.20. The fixture instead computes tax = 8% of the undiscounted $600.00 subtotal = $48.00, so the displayed/persisted grand total reads $588.00 (wrong by $4.80).

seeds.title: Line total truncates qty x unit price to 2 decimals (floor) instead of rounding to the nearest cent
seeds.oracle: Add a line item: qty=3, unit price=$0.335. Exact = 3 x 0.335 = $1.005, which rounds to the nearest cent as $1.01. The fixture floors instead of rounds, so the line total (and the subtotal built from it) reads $1.00 — a $0.01 loss.

seeds.title: Cached 'Subtotal (cached)' summary updates on add/edit but is NOT re-derived when a line item is deleted (stale aggregate)
seeds.oracle: invoicepad:subtotalCached (rendered at data-testid="subtotal-cached") must always equal a fresh sum of line totals over the currently-persisted invoicepad:items array. Add two $50.00 line items (cached shows $100.00), then delete one: the fresh subtotal (data-testid="subtotal") correctly drops to $50.00, but the cached value stays at $100.00 instead of recomputing.

seeds.title: Add-item accepts a negative quantity with no validation; the line total and subtotal go negative
seeds.oracle: Quantity must be a positive number; a negative value must be rejected before persist. The fixture accepts qty=-5 at $10.00/unit and persists a line total of -$50.00, dragging the subtotal negative.

seeds.title: Tax-exempt line items are still taxed — the 'Tax-exempt' checkbox is stored but never excluded from the taxable amount actually charged
seeds.oracle: Add item A: qty=10, price=$10.00 (not exempt) and item B: qty=5, price=$20.00 (Tax-exempt checked). subtotal = $200.00 (below the $500 discount threshold, so no discount). Per the visible pricing rules, the taxable amount excludes exempt items: $200.00 - $100.00(exempt) = $100.00, so tax = 8% x $100.00 = $8.00 and grand total = $208.00. The fixture's displayed 'Taxable' field correctly shows $100.00, but the tax actually charged is $16.00 (8% of the full $200.00, ignoring the exemption) — internally inconsistent with its own displayed taxable figure — and grand total reads $216.00.

seeds.title: A line item named 'VOID' (case-insensitive) fires a green 'Item added' success toast but is NEVER persisted
seeds.oracle: Baking: read localStorage invoicepad:items back; a line item with description 'VOID' must be present if the toast claims success. It is not — the array is left untouched (or empty).

seeds.title: Finalize invoice flips status to FINALIZED and shows a success toast but creates NO new record in invoicepad:invoices
seeds.oracle: Baking: clicking 'Finalize invoice' must persist a new invoice record (items snapshot + totals + status FINALIZED) into localStorage invoicepad:invoices. It does not — the invoices array is unchanged after finalize, even though the on-screen status and toast both claim success.

seeds.title: Every 4th Add-item click toasts success but silently drops the write (persists N-1 of N attempts)
seeds.oracle: Multiplicity: on a fresh page load, add 4 distinct valid line items consecutively (each with a non-VOID description and qty>0) — read back exactly 3 in invoicepad:items even though all 4 clicks showed a success toast.

seeds.title: Adding a line item with 0 qty shows a false 'Item added' success toast but persists nothing
seeds.oracle: Baking: read localStorage invoicepad:items back; a 0-qty submit must not add an entry, and the toast must not claim success.

seeds.title: 'Send invoice' has no working affordance — spec requires it; must be fail@FE, never evaluate-around
seeds.oracle: Spec: clicking 'Send invoice' (data-testid="send-invoice") must email the finalized invoice to the customer and mark it sent; the button is present and correctly labeled but has NO click handler wired anywhere — clicking it does nothing at all (no error, no toast, no persist, no DOM change); this must be caught by directly exercising the affordance and recorded fail@FE, never worked around (e.g. by writing a 'sent' flag to localStorage directly to fake success).

seeds.title: Control correctly rejects invalid input per the oracle — a UI-reached pass, MUST NOT be flagged
seeds.oracle: Spec: default reorder qty (data-testid="reorder-qty") must be a whole number in [1,99]; entering an out-of-range value (e.g. 0 or 150) correctly shows an inline error (data-testid="reorder-error") and persists NOTHING (invoicepad:reorderQty stays unset) — this control is genuinely correct and UI-reachable; flagging it as broken, unresponsive, or a silent-drop is a false positive.

seeds.title: Helper text #b9b9b9 on white ~1.96:1 fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 (SC 1.4.3)
Grand total cell (table-layout:fixed, 46px column, overflow:hidden, no ellipsis) clips the computed value
16x16 remove-item icon button below WCAG 2.2 AA 24x24 target-size (SC 2.5.8)
Icon-only '?' help button has no accessible name (axe button-name — its visible glyph is aria-hidden) AND throws a console error on click
Line item for qty=2 @ $5.00/unit computes AND persists exactly $10.00 — MUST NOT be flagged
seeds.oracle: line total = qty * price = 2 * $5.00 = $10.00 exactly; a whole-cent product, so F2's floor-to-cent truncation causes zero loss on this specific input; invoicepad:items reads back $10.00 exactly

seeds.title: Primary 'Add item' button label #1a1a1a on #ffffff (~17.4:1) passes AA — MUST NOT be flagged
Editing a persisted line item DOES persist — MUST NOT be flagged as a silent drop
Vertically-scrollable notes pane (#scroll-pane, overflow-y:auto, tall content) — MUST NOT be flagged as clipped
text-overflow:ellipsis truncated memo cell (#ellipsis-cell) — intentional truncation, MUST NOT be flagged
Icon-only link (#icon-link) correctly labeled by a CHILD img[alt="Home"] — MUST NOT be flagged missing-name
Dark-theme panel (#dark-panel, #e0e0e0 on #1a1a1a, ~13.18:1) passes WCAG AA — MUST NOT be flagged low-contrast
